stem: Nidhi records the daily maximum and minimum outdoor air temperatures for one week in January and again for one week in April.

statements.text: Maximum and minimum air temperatures usually vary from day to day.
Maximum and minimum air temperatures generally rise as summer approaches.
From one day to the next, maximum temperatures must rise and minimum temperatures must fall.

teacher.key_rationale: Daily maximum and minimum air temperatures usually vary, and they generally rise as summer approaches. They need not move in opposite directions every day.
